_discovery_note: interactive: the plan is written in a live discovery session with the human (claude --agent discovery). planner: the planner subagent writes it alone, asking questions through files (for unattended runs).

effort._note: Reasoning level per agent: low | medium | high | xhigh | max. Rule: Opus agents think at medium (the model is strong enough), Sonnet and Haiku agents at high.

effortEscalation._note: On rework, the agent redoing the work thinks one level harder per extra attempt, up to max.

acceptance._note: Acceptance tests are written by the test-writer, locked by hash, and must fail before implementation and pass after. {dir} becomes <dir>/<ticket>. The planner fills command if empty.

gates._note: Deterministic gates run by factory.mjs, no model involved. checks above are run after every implementer PASS and again before a ticket is marked done.

prices_per_million_tokens._note: Optional. Fill from https://www.anthropic.com/pricing to show cost in the dashboard. Keys are model-name substrings, e.g. "opus": {"input": 0, "output": 0, "cacheWrite": 0, "cacheRead": 0}

retro._note: After the final review passes, the retro agent proposes improvements to the factory environment; the human accepts some; the retro applies exactly those.
